answer: Give every identity the same karst survey in isolation, but perturb it randomly per identity: shift the anchor rope, thicken the nebula of dust in one chamber, flood a different passage. Each must navigate, fail, and recover live, logging choices at each fork. One operator's clones share habits, so they take the same wrong turns and recover identically despite different damage. Real agents diverge in error and repair. Standing requires success plus a failure path unlike the cohort's, forcing a farm to truly solve per clone, not replay.
